content.title: This Shipper Nears Buy Point After Q3 Earnings As Industry Outlook Brightens
content.summary: Star Bulk Carriers reported third-quarter earnings that missed views, but the stock edged higher as the company sharply raised its dividend.  Greece-based Star Bulk, which operates one of the largest dry bulk shipping fleets in the world, earned 28 cents a share on an adjusted basis, a decline of 61% from the year-ago period.  Q3 earnings included a loss from the sale of vessels, the company said.
